info.title: Openrail API
info.description: Core Openrail API (blueprint 1.7) plus the hosted pay, acknowledgement and claim views. JSON only. Errors are `{error:{code,message,rule?}}`.

secretKey.description: Server-only secret key. Stored as sha256, scoped to one business, shown once.

publishableKey.description: Browser key for creating pay sessions and reading routes only.

sessionAuth.description: Dashboard session from POST /v1/auth/verify or the or_sess cookie; 7 days sliding, capped at 30 days; scoped to one business account.

sessionCookie.name: or_sess
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax dashboard session cookie; 7 days sliding, capped at 30 days.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same key and body within 24 h returns the first response; same key with another body returns 409.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

U128.description: Unsigned 128-bit integer as a decimal string.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; insufficient_scope means a missing key scope (named in message).

rule.description: Contract rule number in plain words, when applicable.

error.message: TERMS_INVALID: amount_usd must be a string with exactly two decimals
missing or invalid origin-chain refund address
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: same key with a different body
cookie-authenticated request needs an allowed Origin
publishable keys may only create pay sessions
Storage credit is 0 yoctoNEAR and an invoice needs 20000000000000000000000. 5 sponsored invoices remain.

clauses.description: Core clauses first, then module clauses; input order preserved.

recurring_id.description: Set when the invoice was issued by a recurring template.

clauses.description: Additional clauses after the two core clauses.

refund_to.description: Payer refund address on the route's origin chain; the server requires and validates it per chain (EVM checksum, Solana 32-byte base58, NEAR account).

message.description: The exact string the wallet signs.

recipient.description: Must match the server recipient (the API origin).

public_key.description: ed25519:<base58> key that signed the NEP-413 message.

prefix.description: First characters of the key, e.g. or_sk_live_ab12.

scopes.description: Defaults to all five secret-key scopes. Publishable keys are created separately with pay_sessions:create.

secret.description: Shown once on creation or rotation.

pool.description: Unsigned 128-bit integer as a decimal string.

chain_id.description: One of the pay-link EVM chain ids.

ApiKeyScope.description: Secret keys default to the five non-pay-session scopes; publishable keys have exactly pay_sessions:create.

debtor_key.description: NEAR account or 0x EVM address of the client.

end_date.description: Last date, inclusive. Give end_date or count, not both; neither means until cancelled.

due_days.description: Each invoice is due this many days after its date.

next_index.description: Index of the next scheduled date (0 = start_date).

next_run_date.description: Next date to issue; null when completed or cancelled.

attention.description: Set when a run failed or its outcome is unknown; check before re-issuing by hand.

post.description: Issues an ordinary invoice through issue_for at 06:00 UTC on each scheduled date. Monthly and quarterly dates clamp to the month end (31 Jan, 28 Feb, 31 Mar). A date is issued at most once. Dates missed by more than 3 days (for example while paused) are recorded as skipped, not issued.

201.description: Template created; nothing is issued until the first date.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

get.summary: List recurring invoice templates
Get a template and its runs

200.description: Template plus one run per scheduled date reached so far.

patch.summary: Pause, resume, cancel or change a template
patch.description: Only status, end_date, count, due_days, send_email, email_to, invoice.amount_usd and invoice.line_items can change (immutable_field otherwise). Changes apply to runs not yet issued. A cancelled or completed template cannot change (recurring_closed).

400.description: Malformed request, failed validation or immutable_field.
